g.text: Integral-pan interface: fixed cover / bolted riser rail
WITHDRAWN AS PREFERRED DETAIL. Geometric trial retains integral 420 × 131.5 mm pan; no HAD change.
Rear leg continues to −45 mm wet floor (cropped).
SOUTH / fixed floor
NORTH / pan withdrawal →
Fixed return continues to proposed field at −80..−79 mm.
1 mm central apron slide gap; cover top +5 mm / existing crest +15 mm.
Fixed rail closes face-to-face at Y4060; groove bottom Y4058.68.
Bolts and both as-yet-undesigned end closures release before NORTH 500 mm.
Finite burden, no seal or force pass
4 mm cover reach 27 mm; 3 mm rail / 10 mm land
1.519 kg cover + 0.422 kg rail before ends
37 locations need individually closed penetrations
M3 is a shank reference, not selected hardware.
Circular seal burden 26.70 kN
1.32 mm groove depth +0.08 / −0 is NOT a
permitted open flange gap or formed-pan tolerance.
Catalogue 20–150 mm rings do not supply this U.
Groove-to-hole web only 0.625 mm.
Need face stiffness, machining, preload and ends.
1 mm slide gap is nominal, not a tolerance pass.
New +5 mm cover step changes the walking line.
No wet-floor fixing or field-to-pan weld credited.
Black: existing integral pan wet/reference profile. Blue: new fixed cover/return. Ochre: fixed grooved rail, welded to the cover.
Central-section geometry clears after bolt release; pan end-wall extent, removable end caps, full body sweep and restored air/water joints remain open.
The steel/metal family, cleaning, welds, plating and every retained accessory need full constituent disclosure.
If the complete gap, movement and end closures cannot work, reject or redesign the interface; do not detach the apron by assumption.
This detail is one branch of the whole-field comparison, not envelope selection, physical renewal, first-wetting or material admission.
